purpose: Read-only explicit small-code backup inventory; preserves repository relative paths beneath code/
caveats: Historical source variants are deliberately retained as code lineage; corrected authoritative run uses replication_executor_batch20_env_v3 and replication_statistics_batch20_env_v3 with the frozen verifier/dynamic scheduler/takeover.

The old scripts/plot_paper3_figures.py and LATEST_PAPER3_SCIENTIFIC_FREEZE.md belong to pre-correction evidence. The corrected figure bundle and final verified evidence documents govern final numbers.
Source files preserve local absolute paths and exact dependency pins. This is a source/evidence backup, not a tested portable installation or self-contained one-command rerun.

Only source/config/model files in this list were freshly hashed. No scientific models, tests or statistics were executed. Saved 1200-trajectory raw and 13192-file environment checks were not repeated.
Some current source snapshots have no final manifest pin; this is stated file by file. Any historical pin mismatch is reported rather than rewritten.

Seven current verifier/scheduler files differ from early static implementation manifests. All seven match later authorized execution-freeze manifests; early hashes remain visible in per-file checks and are explicitly marked superseded.
13 model binaries total 904571 bytes: the final archive indexes 12 bank/A1 files, while the original scientific adapter additionally binds the 4485-byte P6 estimator. Both are retained.

excluded.reason: Large or mixed historical/result data are outside the requested source backup. Final evidence ZIP is handled separately.
excluded.scope: All results trees, raw trajectory CSVs, canonical NPY/NPZ input arrays, model execution task states, logs and synthetic-test output

excluded.reason: Environment/security/generated content excluded; exact lock and runtime metadata are included.

excluded.reason: Use one working source tree plus explicit source hash pins; final verified evidence ZIP is handled separately.
excluded.scope: Repeated archived source copies inside handoffs and failed/historical ZIP blobs
